issues.reason: 素材只说明记账户代替收押金（instead of taking deposits），「no receipts」是对店铺做法的额外断言，材料中没有依据
issues.suggestion: 改为「No deposits.」，只保留素材支持的否定
issues.source_quote: Ruth keeps a ledger of house accounts for a dozen longtime customers instead of taking deposits.

issues.quote: If you are on the list you pay at the end of the month, and that is the whole arrangement.
issues.reason: 「月底结算」是材料中没有的具体付款条款，素材只说有 house accounts、不收押金，结算时间属于无来源的事实补充
issues.suggestion: 改为可从素材直接推出的说法，如「If you are on the list you do not pay up front, and that is the whole arrangement.」，或删去结算时间并标记待补
issues.source_quote: Ruth keeps a ledger of house accounts for a dozen longtime customers instead of taking deposits.

issues.quote: The rest of the week the prices come out right the first time, because Ruth is the one doing the lookups.
issues.reason: 素材只覆盖周六（侄子每次查价都错），对其余六天价格情况的概括和因果解释均无来源；同时这句把前一句的对照解释掉了，削弱了结尾
issues.suggestion: 以「Ruth calls the right number from wherever she is.」收尾，删去这句概括
issues.source_quote: On Saturdays her nephew works the register and gets every price lookup wrong.
